keys.title: BWERANI NDI MAKIYI ANU
keys.sub: Ogwira ntchito akufuna makiyi anu kuti alandire foni iyi
keys.intro: NarrateBot 3000 imagwira ntchito ndi kiyi yanu ya Gemini pofotokoza ndipo, mukafuna, kiyi ya ElevenLabs ya mawu.
keys.geminiSteps: Lowani, sankhani Create API key, kenako matani kiyi apa.
keys.geminiCost: Google imapereka gawo laulere lokhala ndi malire; kugwiritsa ntchito kwambiri kumalipiritsidwa ku akaunti yanu ya Google.
keys.elevenSteps: Pangani kiyi yokhala ndi mwayi wa Text to Speech, kenako muimatani apa.
keys.elevenCost: Dongosolo laulere lili ndi zilembo zololedwa mwezi uliwonse. Mawu ena amafuna dongosolo lolipira; ngati mawu palibe timagwiritsa ntchito mawu wamba, kapena mawu a msakatuli wanu ngati musiya malo awa opanda kanthu.
keys.privacy: Makiyi anu amasungidwa mu cookie yotetezedwa mwachinsinsi (encrypted) mu msakatuli uyu ndipo amatumizidwa ku seva yathu pokhapokha kuti tichite zopempha zanu. Sitiwasunga kapena kuwalemba konse. Mungawachotse nthawi iliyonse mu Zokonda.
keys.geminiInvalid: Google sinavomere kiyi ya Gemini imeneyo. Ifufuzeni ndipo yesaninso.
keys.format: Imeneyo sikuoneka ngati kiyi ya API. Matani kiyi yonse, popanda mipata.
keys.formatEleven: Kiyi ya ElevenLabs imeneyo sikuoneka bwino. Matani kiyi yonse, kapena isiyeni yopanda kanthu.
keys.failed: Sitinathe kufufuza kiyi yanu pakali pano. Yesaninso posachedwa.
keys.needKeys: Kuti mupitirize kufotokoza, onjezani makiyi anu.
keys.quota: Kiyi yanu ya Gemini yafika malire ake. Tiyesanso pakapita mphindi imodzi…
keys.badKey: Google yakana kiyi yanu ya Gemini. Ifufuzeni kapena matani yatsopano.
keys.removed: Makiyi anu achotsedwa. Onjezani makiyi kuti mupitirize kufotokoza.

documentary: Ndipo apa tikuwona msonkhano wa mtundu uwu, aliyense wolemekezeka kuposa wam'mbuyo. Zoonadi, chilengedwe chili pabwino kwambiri.
Chitsanzo chodabwitsa chikuwerama kutsogolo, maso ali pa sikirini yowala, ndi kuleza mtima kwa cholengedwa chodziwa kuti zinthu zazikulu zimatenga nthawi.
Onani kudzidalira kwachete kwa gulu ili. Palibe ngakhale m'modzi amene wachita mantha, ngakhale ali kutali chotere ndi kumene amapeza zokhwasula-khwasula.
Gululo lasonkhana mozungulira kuwala, monga momwe makolo awo anachitira. Zinthu zina, zikuoneka, n'zamuyaya.
Chitsanzo chimodzi chikukonza kakhalidwe kake ndi ulemu waukulu. Enawo akuona. Mtsogoleri watulukira.
Kuthengo, zolengedwa zochepa kwambiri zingakhale pa chiwonetsero ndi ulemu wotere. Komabe, ali pano. Zodabwitsa.
documentaryStill: Gulu silinasunthe. Ngakhale pang'ono. Wofotokoza, kumbali yake, akadali ndi chiyembekezo.
Palibebe kanthu. Zitsanzozi zikuoneka kuti zikusunga mphamvu, mwina za kuwomba m'manja.
Patha nthawi tsopano. Munthu akuyamba kukayikira kuti gulu likudikira wofotokoza kuti aseketse. Akuyesetsa.
Bata lathunthu. Asayansi ali ndi mawu a khalidwe ili. Mawuwo ndi 'kuweruza.'
Wofotokoza waonapo zomera za m'nyumba zokhala ndi chikhumbo chooneka kuposa pamenepa. Chonde, wina, aliyense, sunthani chala.
Musadandaule, gulu lili bwino kotheratu. Akungosankha, ndi ulemu waukulu, kusasuntha.
funny: M'dziko... momwe chipinda chimodzi chinalimba mtima kuonera laputopu... ngwazi ibadwa. Yovomerezeka kwa onse, makamaka okongola.
Nyengo ino... gulu la alendo anzeru... ndi webukamu yomwe yaona zambiri. OWONERA. Tsopano m'malo owonera makanema.
Kuchokera ku situdiyo yomwe inakubweretserani kukhala pansi... ikubwera gawo lake lachiwiri lolimba mtima kwambiri. KUKHALA PANSI 2: TIDAKALI PANSI.
Otsutsa akuti ndi 'gulu lovala bwino kwambiri lomwe laputopu inajambulapo.' Ikubwera posachedwa m'chipinda chomwe chino.
Chipinda chimodzi. Palibe kuphulika. Chikoka chopanda malire. HACKATHON. Zala zazikulu ziwiri m'mwamba kwambiri.
Anabwera chifukwa cha chiwonetsero... anakhala chifukwa cha zokhwasula-khwasula zaulere... OBWERA. Zatsopano zotsimikizika.
funnyStill: M'nyengo yozizira ino... palibe chilichonse chikuchitika. Ndipo n'zodabwitsa. MOYO WABATA: FILIMU.
Ngwazi khumi ndi ziwiri. Chipinda chimodzi. Palibe kusuntha. ZIBOLIBOLI. Bata lokayikitsa.
Kuchokera kwa wotsogolera KUDIKIRA... ikubwera KUDIKIRA 2: TIKADALI KUDIKIRA. Otsutsa akuti 'imakukhazika pansi kwambiri.'
M'dziko lomwe palibe amene akusuntha... wofotokoza mmodzi... akupempha. Chonde. Aliyense. Kwezani dzanja.
Ikubwera posachedwa: KUIMA KWAUTALI KWAMBIRI. Mphindi makumi asanu ndi anayi. Chipinda chimodzi. Palibe ngakhale kuphethira kamodzi.
M'chilimwe chino... owonera akukumana ndi vuto lawo lalikulu... kukweza dzanja limodzi. CHIZINDIKIRO. Tsopano ikuwonetsedwa.
descriptive: Sindinathe kupeza kufotokoza pakali pano. Gwirani kamera mosasuntha ndipo ndiyesanso.
pumpkin: He he he... takulandirani, mlendo wolimba mtima! Ndi chovala chotani! Chokongola ngati dzungu.
Bu! Ha, ndakuopsani? Chovala chanu ndithudi chandiopsa ine, m'njira yabwino kwambiri.
Oho, bwerani pafupi, bwerani pafupi... Ndimakonda mlendo wa kalembedwe. Mwawalitsa nkhope yanga yonse.
He he... chovala chabwino cha usiku wabwino. Ndikuwala ndi nsanje.
Takulandirani, takulandirani! Ndikadakukumbatirani, koma mkati ndine wopanda kanthu. Chovala chokongola, komabe.
He he he... ndaona zovala zambiri usiku uno, koma chanu? Chochititsa mantha mokongola.
